about: The validation set's 33 Home Depot bundle pages, read 2026-11-18 in the owner's Chrome from a homedepot.com tab with fetch('/p/<itemId>') (no SerpApi). Each is a ProductPage (core/src/hdPage.ts): identifiers, the pricing entry's value and original, and only the bullets the splitter reads — RYOBI bullets starting 'Includes', and for DEWALT the first bullet per leading model ('MODEL:'), cut to 70 characters. Equivalent for splitting to the full page. Titles had runs of spaces collapsed by the export. 15 are the bundles of the owner's real scan of Nov 17; 18 were chosen from Home Depot's own search for variety (kit + free tool, special buys, tool-only pairs, DEWALT kit + battery, battery multipacks).
